title: 📖 Delivery-model glossary
help: The full vocabulary of the delivery-model referential, each term mapped to its AgentCase equivalent. It exists because most disagreements in an agentic business-case review turn out to be terminological — two people using "supervision", "maturity" or "capacity" to mean different things and arguing about the numbers instead.
— same concept, same name in both. No translation needed.
— the referential's concept, implemented here as a concrete feature, often under a different name. This is where the translation matters.
— a quantification the referential describes qualitatively but does not compute. These are the places where the tool goes beyond the method it implements.

The search filters by term, definition and category as you type. It updates only the results body, so the field keeps focus across keystrokes — you can type a whole term without the input dropping out from under you.
The glossary can also be displayed
inside each section rather than as its own tab (the setting lives in Import/Export). When inline mode is on, this tab hides itself from the menu to avoid two routes to the same content.
